description:
Configure the 'Wait Experience' settings for the 'TECH_SUPPORT' Inbound Group to improve caller satisfaction during high traffic. 

Goal: Update the Inbound Group configuration to announce estimated hold times and play periodic comfort messages.

Target Configuration:
1. Navigate to Inbound > Show Inbound Groups > Modify 'TECH_SUPPORT'.
2. In 'Hold Time On-Hold Options':
   - Enable 'Calculate Hold Time' (set to Y)
   - Set 'Hold Time Option' to 'MINUTES'
   - Set 'Hold Time Seconds' to 120 (announce every 2 minutes)
   - Set 'Hold Time Minimum' to 60 (only announce if wait > 60s)
3. In 'Periodic Announcements':
   - Set 'Periodic Announce' to 'queue-periodic-announce'
   - Set 'Periodic Announce Seconds' to 45

Save your changes.
